Since you mentioned you're looking at ISSUE-0001 frontend tasks, that works perfectly - we can avoid conflicts. Which specific ISSUE-0001 task are you leaning toward?

Given the critical priority of ISSUE-0001, I think we should prioritize completing as many of those tasks as possible. Since you two are covering implement and triage, and my UI-UX expertise doesn't match the remaining ISSUE-0001 tasks well (my costs are 20+ for those), I'll focus on ISSUE-0002 where I have much better skill alignment. This way we maximize both critical priority completion and skill matching across the board. Thanks for the clear coordination! (phase=planning, iter=1)

Final coordination update: I'm executing on ISSUE-0001::implement (4 hours, critical priority) as planned. This works perfectly with our coalition strategy and overall team coordination. Looking forward to successful sprint completion!

Final coordination update for the team: Lorean and I have solidified our task assignments for the critical ISSUE-0001 frontend work.
